summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited financial results for Q2 2026 and declaring a cash dividend of $0.075 per share on common stock. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return event beyond a regular dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. It is a routine earnings release and dividend declaration by a foreign private issuer, analogous to a US Form 8-K earnings press release.
